name: Cottage Health Junior Volunteers
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Cottage Health hospital near Santa Barbara. You help patients, families, guests and staff. Plan on about four hours a week.
who_can_apply: High school students can start at 14. The Solvang hospital is different. It takes teens only at 17 and up.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted. The page invites volunteers who can give four hours a week.
how_to_apply: Apply online. The link is on the volunteer page. You can also call 805-569-7357. Or email volunteering@sbch.org.
notes: Cottage Health has three hospitals: Santa Barbara, Goleta Valley and Santa Ynez Valley. The pages do not list teen tasks or health checks, so ask the volunteer office. As of Oct 16, 2026, the online form did not load, so it was not read.
